# Quality Target

This folder documents the specific performance thresholds that healthcare departments are expected to achieve within clinical quality registries. These targets are critical for standardizing care and evaluating adherence to evidence-based practices, such as the developmental goal requiring more than 60% of laparotomy patients to receive epidural analgesia. By tracking these benchmarks, clinical teams can identify gaps in perioperative care and guide quality improvement initiatives.

## Pages

- [[quality-target|Quality Target]] — Defines performance thresholds for clinical indicators, including the >60% epidural administration target for laparotomy patients.
